summary: Iteration 7 full-stack regression of AbsenSPG after replacing mocked saves with real MongoDB persistence. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (61 tests incl. the legacy report file) covering auth (cookie/httpOnly/bcrypt/401/422), masters + Admin/Guru role guards, attendance & grades save->GET round-trip and upsert keys, journals, settings RBAC, and report rows/xlsx/print built from real DB rows - 61/61 passing. Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390): Guru login hides Administration nav; attendance roster loads per class (7A=6, 7B=3, 8A=3), statuses+notes save and are restored on reload; grades save/restore and class average update; journal validation toast, save, form clear and list refresh; Admin master add for Siswa/Kelas/Mapel/Guru with list refresh + search filter + empty state; settings save persists across reload and updates topbar; Excel export returns the correct kind for all 3 selections (iteration_5 regression fixed) and print popup title = 'Rekap Jurnal Mengajar' with real journal rows and saved school name. No blocking bugs found.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout: 6 consecutive wrong passwords do not lock the account and a valid login still succeeds (auth playbook requires lockout after 5 fails). No attempt counter/lock fields in users collection.
Grades rows omit assessment_type, so Formatif and Sumatif entries for the same student/date/subject render as indistinguishable rows in Excel/print.
Hard .to_list(200) cap on source documents silently truncates reports; no pagination or date/class/subject filter params supported.
Only POST exists for students/classes/subjects/teachers - no PUT/DELETE, so test or wrong data cannot be edited/removed via API (had to clean TEST_ rows directly in MongoDB).

ui_bugs.issue: Row option buttons and toolbar 'more' button are no-op (no menu, no edit/delete)

'Tampilkan rekap' (report-preview-button) downloads the Excel file instead of showing a preview; the preview paper shows a hardcoded 'SMP PGRI Gandoang' header and static bar chart instead of the saved settings school name / real data
report-class-select / report-subject-select / report-period-select are not wired to the API - export & print always return all rows
'Riwayat absensi', 'Impor Excel' and topbar search buttons are decorative no-ops

integration_issues.issue: printReport() has no try/catch and does not handle blocked popups - an API failure produces an unhandled promise rejection with no user feedback (export path does show a toast)

issues: Native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) are used instead of a locale-aware / shadcn calendar, inconsistent with the Indonesian UI which formats dates as 'Rabu, 26 Agustus 2026' elsewhere
Single shared toast with 2.6s timer: a new save can display while the previous message is still visible, so the visible text can lag behind the last action (observed in test timing)

action_items: Add login brute-force lockout (5 failed attempts -> temporary lock) per auth playbook
Wire report class/subject/period filters (or remove them) and make 'Tampilkan rekap' render a real preview from /api/reports/rows using settings school name
Include assessment_type in grades report rows; replace the .to_list(200) cap with filters/pagination
Add PUT/DELETE for master data or hide the non-functional row/toolbar option buttons
Wrap printReport in try/catch with a toast fallback and handle blocked popups
critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed_accounts() unconditionally $sets password_hash on every startup, silently resetting any password changed at runtime - move password_hash into $setOnInsert or gate on an explicit reseed flag
JWT_SECRET falls back to secrets.token_hex(32) when the env var is missing, which would invalidate every session on restart - fail fast instead (env var is present today)
App.js packs whole components onto single 1000+ character lines; split Attendance/Grades/Journal/Master/Reports into src/components files for reviewability
report_rows() is called directly by export/print with a manually passed user dict, bypassing FastAPI dependency semantics - extract a plain helper to avoid coupling endpoint signatures
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_real_accounts_reports.py (removed stale mocked-data assertions: max_row==7 and hardcoded 'Alya Putri')

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login/RBAC, attendance, grades, journal, master CRUD-create, settings, reports export/print, mobile nav) - remaining issues are unwired decorative controls

seed_data_creation: Test attendance (2026-07-02 7B IPA, 2026-07-10 7B Matematika), grades (2026-07-02 8A Informatika Formatif+Sumatif, 7B Formatif) and 5 journals remain in DB as report fixtures. All TEST_/UITEST master rows were deleted from MongoDB after testing (7A back to 6 students, 4 classes/4 subjects/3 teachers); settings restored to 'SMP PGRI Gandoang'.
test_credentials: admin@absenspg.local / Admin123! (Admin), guru@absenspg.local / Guru123! (Guru) - from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, both valid
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public url> python -m pytest tests/ -q -o addopts='' . backend_test.py is the canonical suite; it creates TEST_<hash> master rows that CANNOT be deleted via API (no DELETE endpoints) - clean with a direct motor delete_many({'name': {'$regex': '^(TEST_|UITEST)'}}) on students/classes/subjects/teachers, otherwise 7A student counts drift and roster-count assertions (7A=6) fail. CORS preflight is answered by the ingress with '*', so CORS credential headers must be asserted against http://localhost:8001 (documented in the test). Dashboard stats, Jadwal page and manual backup are mocked by design.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect reproduced this iteration. The two initial test failures were test-side: (1) CORS preflight assertions hit the CDN instead of FastAPI (app config verified correct on localhost:8001), (2) my grades-report assertion keyed rows by student name, which collides because report rows omit assessment_type - that collision is itself reported as a minor backend reporting gap.
